name: Classic Ranthambore Wildlife Escape
summary: The ideal weekend wilderness escape. Includes 2 game drives into prime tiger territory, 4-star resort stay, buffet meals, and station transfers.

items.title: 2 Jungle Safaris
items.text: Thrilling open Gypsy or Canter drives across Ranthambore tiger zones.

items.title: 4-Star Resort Stay
items.text: AC deluxe cottage or Swiss tent with swimming pool.

items.title: All Meals Included
items.text: Delicious buffet breakfasts, lunches, and dinners with local specialties.

items.title: Station Pickup & Drop
items.text: Private transfer from Sawai Madhopur Junction railway station.

blocks.heading: Day-by-Day Safari Itinerary
blocks.intro: Action-packed wildlife schedule crafted for optimal tiger viewing.

items.label: Day 1
items.title: Arrival, Check-In & Evening Safari
bullets: 12:00 PM: Arrive at Sawai Madhopur station. Private escort to luxury jungle resort & check-in.
01:30 PM: Buffet lunch at the resort dining hall.
02:30 PM: Board your first afternoon tiger safari into the jungle. Return at sunset.
07:30 PM: Evening folk music by the bonfire followed by dinner.

items.label: Day 2
items.title: Morning Safari & Ranthambore Fort
bullets: 06:00 AM: Early morning core zone tiger safari. Track predators at dawn.
10:30 AM: Hearty breakfast & leisure time by the swimming pool.
03:00 PM: Guided visit to the 10th-century UNESCO Ranthambore Fort & Trinetra Ganesha Temple.

items.label: Day 3
items.title: Breakfast & Departure
bullets: 08:30 AM: Breakfast amidst bird songs and lush green surroundings.
11:00 AM: Check out and transfer to Sawai Madhopur station.

groups.title: What is Included
items: 2 Nights accommodation in Deluxe Resort on twin sharing basis
2 Jungle Safaris (Gypsy or Canter based on booking)
All forest entry permits, vehicle taxes & government cess
Licensed Forest Department naturalist guide for both safaris

groups.title: What is Excluded
items: Train or flight tickets to Sawai Madhopur
Tips for naturalist and safari driver

items.title: Deluxe AC Cottages
items.text: Spacious cottages with ensuite bathrooms, wooden furniture & private garden verandas.

items.title: Delicious Buffet Dining
items.text: Hygienic multi-cuisine spreads with Indian curries, continental breakfast & Rajasthani Dal Baati.

items.title: Swimming Pool & Lawns
items.text: Relax amidst green manicured lawns, take a refreshing dip, or enjoy stargazing by the open bonfire.

items.q: Can we upgrade from Canter to Gypsy in this package?
items.a: Yes! Both Canter sharing and private 6-seater Gypsy options are available with customizable pricing.
Yes, partner resorts feature swimming pools, sprawling lawns, and child-friendly meal options.

items.q: Which resort will we be staying at?
items.a: We partner with vetted 4-star properties such as Ranthambore Regency, Tiger Den, and The Tigress.

blocks.title: Reserve Your 2N/3D Weekend Wildlife Tour
blocks.text: Customizable for couples, families, and wildlife enthusiasts. Lock in early permits and best resort cottages with our local team.
